hypothesis_name: Prospective US price quality with dilution overlay
first_permissible_vintage: 2026-10 month-end after registration, only when the exact US session and FX are complete
economic_rationale: Price behaviour remains primary. Lower point-in-time year-over-year diluted-share growth may indicate less owner dilution; a fixed small overlay is economically pre-registered after exploratory evidence and requires genuinely prospective confirmation. The 90/10 weight was not historically optimized.
eligible_universe: Current-catalogue US common stocks with an existing model-ready price observation and defensible point-in-time dilution evidence; permanently unmapped SEC securities are reported separately.
score_formula: 0.90 * existing price-only percentile + 0.10 * dilution percentile, where lower year-over-year diluted-share growth ranks higher and buybacks may rank favourably
eligibility_and_withholding: Missing, stale, nonfinite, incompatible, unreliable, late-filed or late-retrieved share observations are unavailable and are never zero, neutral or poor. Leverage, profitability, cash flow, growth and valuation are diagnostics only and never ranking inputs.
tie_breaking: prospective score descending, then qualified symbol ascending
rebalance_cadence: monthly after a complete US month-end session and required FX readiness
outcome_definitions: Complete equal-weight total price returns at the exact 126th and 252nd subsequent trading sessions; missing or integrity-excluded members make the cohort incomplete
baselines: matching top-three price-only selections using identical eligible securities and decision date
equal-weight eligible-US universe using identical decision date
integrity_gates: publicly available and retrieved by decision timestamp
prohibited_retrospective_changes: no vintage at or before registration
no reconstruction of September 2026 or earlier
no changing this version after its first vintage
no production publication or broker action
